claims.citation: New York Herald, 22 May 1866, p. 9, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Ship Liverpool, Chamberlain, London and Isle of Wight,
April 22, with mdse and passengers, to Grinnell, Minturn &
Co. May 14, lat 40 38, lon 61 25, was in company with ship
Excelsior, from Liverpool for New York; 16th, boarded brig
Cascatelle (see Marine Disasters).

Ship Liverpool, Chamberlin, London and Isle of Wight April 23[?],
with mdse. and 592 pass. to Grinnell, Minturn & Co. May 14, lat. 40
38[?], lon. 61 25, was in company with ship Excelsior, from Liverpool
for New-York.
